note: CURATED guide catalog - hand-authored, never auto-written. The weekly wiki refresh FLAGS a guide whose source page changed (by intersecting the sources' page titles with the week's edits) and a human re-authors it; nothing here is generated. Every Authored objective answers who + where + what and cites the page it came from; every Stub says out loud what the wiki does not tell us, because a wrong instruction costs a player an evening and a stub costs them a browser tab. Guides layer BESIDE the harvested QuestCatalog and ON TOP of the Sky checklist: an objective's rewardKey is an existing QuestChecklistLayout.RewardKey ('Class|Reward'), so a turn-in stays one fact in one store. GuideCatalogTests holds all of that. Warrior, Monk and Druid authored 2026-09-09 from each class's own eqlwiki Plane of Sky Tests page; the item rows are exactly the ones SkyQuestDefaults already curates, so every box a player has ticked still counts.

guides.name: Azure Ruby Ring - Warrior, Plane of Sky
guides.questName: Warrior Sky Test: Azure Ruby Ring

objectives.title: Loot the Azure Ring from Gorgalosk
objectives.shortInstruction: Kill Gorgalosk on Isle 3 and loot the Azure Ring.
objectives.where: Plane of Sky - Isle 3.
objectives.what: Kill Gorgalosk and loot Azure Ring (1).
objectives.when: Whenever Gorgalosk is up - it is a single named spawn, so the wait is the spawn cycle rather than a drop rate.
objectives.why: Azure Ring is one of the turn-in pieces for the Azure Ruby Ring.
objectives.how: Kill the named and loot it. Bring whatever it takes to hold a Sky named; nobody has recorded a solo kill for us.

objectives.title: Collect Wind Rune Neza
objectives.shortInstruction: Loot a Wind Rune Neza from Plane of Sky trash.
objectives.what: Loot Wind Rune Neza (1).
objectives.why: Wind Rune Neza is one of the turn-in pieces for the Azure Ruby Ring.
objectives.stubNote: eqlwiki's Warrior Plane of Sky Tests page does not say which isle or which mob drops Wind Rune Neza, and EQBuddy's Sky checklist records only "Trash mobs". eqlwiki's Monk Plane of Sky Tests page describes wind runes as a random drop from any mob in the Plane of Sky, which is the closest thing to an answer we have for this one. If you have looted it, tell us the isle and the mob - that is what turns this step from a stub into directions.

objectives.title: Hand in Azure Ring, Wind Rune Neza
objectives.shortInstruction: Give Torgon Blademaster the 2 pieces to receive the Azure Ruby Ring.
objectives.where: Plane of Sky - the Efreeti Chamber, through the teleport pad at roughly 1600, 520 on Isle 1.
objectives.what: Hand Torgon Blademaster Azure Ring (1), Wind Rune Neza (1) to receive the Azure Ruby Ring.
objectives.when: Once every piece above is in your bags - the hand-in is the last step and nothing else gates it.
objectives.why: This is the step that actually gives you the Azure Ruby Ring.
objectives.how: A hand-in, not a fight. Give the pieces to the quest-giver; the log never records a turn-in, so tick it yourself when it is done.
